messages:
deploybot: PROMOTE_HOLD: release-window 'v1.42.0' blocked — staging artifact cache restore latency spike. 3/5 artifact fetches timed out, build 3953 smoke failed. Auto-promo held. See /ci/builds/3953 logs.
Alex: ugh. Is it a cache miss flood or upstream registry slowness?
Maria: Looks like our s3 mirror had head/get latency spikes. Getting 120s+ timeouts on restore.
Alex: @ReleaseManager we need a decision — pin to last-good or wait it out? Change window ends in ~40m.
ReleaseManager: Leaning toward manual promote of last-good for this window to avoid user impact. Any objections?
Jen: +1 to manual promote but do a 1% canary first. Also note in release notes that we rolled back to last-good.
Sam: Confirming no DB migrations in this release, safe to pin image-only.
Maria: I pulled the last-good: release-v1.41.7. I can run the manual promote steps. Plan:
- pin image -> release-v1.41.7
- run canary (1%)
- monitor smoke for 10m
Alex: deploybot, can you pin/tag last-good as 'manual-promote-6135793001' and start a 1% canary?
deploybot: :robot_face: ack — cannot auto-pin due to cache error state. Manual trigger required. Run: `/deploy promote --tag release-v1.41.7 --canary 1%` (requires release-owner)
Jen: I'll run it now.
ops-bot: Job started by Jen: `/deploy promote 3953 -> release-v1.41.7 (canary 1%)`
deploybot: Canary launched. Smoke-check window 10m. Artifact fetch timeout threshold = 120s.
Jen: Canary instance smoke passed first 3 minutes. No obvious errors in app logs.
Alex: Watching infra metrics — s3 head latency, ci-cache hit rate, deploybot queue.
Maria: Poked cloud provider — INC-8793 opened for us-west-2 high head latency.
ReleaseManager: Decision: perform manual-promote last-good for this change window. We'll schedule a postmortem and a follow-up to improve cache fallback (prefer local fallback + longer retries for restore).
Alex: documented on release notes and changelog; will add a line under known-issues.
Jen: Manual promote completed to prod. Can we re-enable auto-promote queue after the incident?
deploybot: Auto-promo remains BLOCKED until cache restore error rate < 1% for 1h. Manual override recorded: `manual_promote_by=Jen; tag=release-v1.41.7; reason=cache_restore_spike`
Sam: Thanks all. I'll update the incident playbook with the manual-promote steps and add a small checklist: verify no schema change, run 1% canary, monitor smoke, then scale.
Maria: Log snippet for posterity:
```
ERROR fetch artifact s3://ci-cache/artifacts/sha256:abc123 timeout after 120s
fetch_latency_ms: [2300, 125000, 140000]
stack: http_get -> retry -> timeout
```
Alex: Closing the hold for this window. Please follow up on cloud ticket and we'll reconvene if auto-promote unblock conditions hit.
ReleaseManager: Filing a postmortem task and assigning owners. Thanks team :thumbsup:
